extraction_notes: Only the main article was provided; several quantitative datasets referenced in Supporting Information (Figures S5–S8, S10–S16, S23, S28, S30, S35–S41 and Table S3) are not available here and were not extracted. Figures 1a–c contain many dense conversion/selectivity/yield points versus GHSV; because individual x-axis labels and points are too small/ambiguous in the supplied page image to tie every value exactly to a single catalyst and GHSV without risking wrong numbers, those dense plotted points were not enumerated. CO-hydrogenation-only bars in Figure 3a with 0% CO2 were excluded as out of scope. Methanol-conversion experiments in Figure 2 with methanol feeds were excluded except the gray CO2-hydrogenation comparison bars, because those methanol-fed runs are not CO2 hydrogenation to methanol performance entries.
